source_1_imd_daily.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Gridded Daily Rainfall
source_1_imd_daily.center: Climate Research and Services (CRS), IMD Pune
source_1_imd_daily.missing_data_policy: Flagged as NaN; excluded from spatial mean; no synthetic zero-imputation
source_1_imd_daily.usage_role: Medium-range antecedent wetness context (1-day, 3-day, 7-day catchment accumulation)

source_2_mosdac_insat3ds_hem.name: ISRO/MOSDAC INSAT-3DS Hydro-Estimator Method (HEM)
source_2_mosdac_insat3ds_hem.missing_data_policy: Strict NaN preservation; partial hours explicitly flagged; zero forward/backward filling
source_2_mosdac_insat3ds_hem.usage_role: High-frequency convective rain tracking for Event 1 rising-limb and lag correlation analysis

source_3_cwc_stage_telemetry.name: Central Water Commission (CWC) / Maharashtra WRD Telemetry
source_3_cwc_stage_telemetry.sensor_type: Radar / Pressure Transducer River Stage Telemetry
source_3_cwc_stage_telemetry.units: Meters above mean sea level (m MSL)
source_3_cwc_stage_telemetry.usage_role: Hydrological forecast target and autoregressive stage feature foundation
